exceptions.reason: The affected rsa package remains in Cargo.lock through optional transitive metadata but is absent from the activated Cargo graph for every target and from all bounded release-package normal graphs. The exception fails if it becomes reachable.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove immediately when rsa leaves Cargo.lock, a fixed upstream version is available in the resolved lock, or any activated/release graph reaches rsa.

exceptions.reason: gumdrop is reachable only through the Tendermint test generator used as a dev-dependency by the vendored finality verifier; it is absent from normal all-target and bounded release-package graphs.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when tendermint-testgen no longer requires gumdrop or when the finality test generator is replaced. Any normal or release reachability fails the gate.

exceptions.reason: paste is an unmaintained transitive proc-macro required by flex-error in the pinned Tendermint finality stack. It is not present in any bounded CEX release-package normal graph; replacement requires an upstream Tendermint/flex-error migration.
exceptions.removal_condition: Remove when the pinned Tendermint stack no longer resolves through flex-error/paste. Any reachability from a bounded release package fails the gate.
